title: The Green Hand
text: A hand of living vine reaches up out of a well, green and supple, leaves unfurling at the knuckles. It opens, palm up, patient. It will take the hurt from any wounded arm laid in it, a voice from the well says. It does not say what it gives back.

options.label: The one with the hurt arm lays it in the vine's palm.

outcomes.text: The vine knits the arm, green and gentle, and lets go, and leaves a leaf in the wound.
The vine takes the arm's strength instead of its hurt, and sighs with pleasure.

options.label: Healer's hands ask the well its name.

outcomes.text: It answers, and teaches a little of its green craft.

options.label: Burn it out of the well.

outcomes.text: It screams like a child as it burns, and the ash is worth something.
